# AI Engineer Intern
 
## About Alex AI 
 
 Alex AI is a startup building AI-powered tools that help companies create stronger, clearer, and more effective hiring content. Our work focuses on improving the quality of job descriptions and supporting teams as they communicate roles in a more thoughtful and candidate-friendly way. We move quickly, learn continuously, and apply AI to practical hiring challenges where quality, clarity, and reliability matter.
 
## About the Role 
 
 Alex AI is looking for an AI Engineer Intern to help build, monitor, and evaluate AI systems that generate high-quality LinkedIn job descriptions. In this role, you will work with data, prompts, model outputs, and machine learning pipelines to support the performance and reliability of our AI-driven hiring content tools. You will contribute to the full cycle of AI system improvement, from preparing and cleaning training data to evaluating output quality and supporting comparisons between different model and prompt approaches. This is a hands-on internship for someone who is excited to learn quickly, work on real AI systems, and contribute to visible product impact in a fast-moving startup environment.
 
## Responsibilities 
 
- Monitor machine learning pipelines to help ensure AI systems are running reliably and producing outputs that can be reviewed, evaluated, and improved over time.
- Evaluate the quality of AI-generated job descriptions by reviewing model outputs for clarity, completeness, professionalism, consistency, and alignment with intended hiring content standards.
- Prepare, clean, and organize training data so it can be used effectively in AI development, evaluation, and ongoing model improvement workflows.
- Support prompt testing and model comparison efforts by helping structure experiments, review results, and identify differences in output quality across approaches.
- Collaborate with the team to surface patterns, issues, and opportunities for improvement in the AI systems used to generate hiring content.
- Help translate observations from model evaluation and data review into practical recommendations that improve the quality and usefulness of generated job descriptions.
 
## Requirements 
 
- Working knowledge of Python and the ability to use it for data handling, analysis, automation, or machine learning-related tasks.
- Experience using SQL to query, inspect, or work with structured data in support of analysis, reporting, or pipeline-related workflows.
- Basic understanding of machine learning concepts, including how models are trained, evaluated, and improved using data and feedback.
- Experience working with data pipelines, including familiarity with how data is prepared, transformed, monitored, or moved through technical workflows.
- Ability to review AI-generated content thoughtfully and identify opportunities to improve quality, consistency, and usefulness.
- Strong attention to detail when working with datasets, model outputs, prompts, and evaluation results.
- Interest in applied AI engineering and a willingness to learn quickly in a startup environment where priorities may evolve.
 
## Nice to Have 
 
- Familiarity with system design concepts and an interest in understanding how AI systems are structured, scaled, monitored, or maintained.
- Experience with Figma or comfort working with product and design artifacts when collaborating on user-facing AI tools.
- Frontend development experience that could support collaboration on interfaces, prototypes, or product experiences connected to AI-generated content.
- Exposure to signal processing concepts or related technical coursework that demonstrates strong analytical and mathematical problem-solving ability.
 
## Benefits 
 
- Health insurance to support your overall well-being during your time with the team.
- Covered lunch, breakfast, and dinner to help you stay focused and energized throughout the workday.
- Hands-on AI engineering experience working on real systems that generate, evaluate, and improve hiring content.
- The opportunity to learn in a fast-moving startup environment where interns can contribute directly to meaningful product work.
 
## Why Join Us 
 
 Join Alex AI to work on practical AI systems with real product impact. As an AI Engineer Intern, you will not be limited to observation or isolated tasks; you will help monitor pipelines, evaluate model quality, prepare data, and support prompt and model comparison work that directly contributes to the quality of our hiring content tools. This is an opportunity to learn quickly in a startup setting, collaborate closely with a team building AI for a real customer need, and develop hands-on experience across the workflows that make AI systems useful, reliable, and effective.
 
## Equal Opportunity Statement 
 
 Alex AI is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and fair hiring process.
